build_profiler_context: build a thread-safe ProfilerContext instance to track timing counters and values for simulation operations
run_track_context_manager: run code inside a track context manager to measure execution time for a named category
run_track_time_decorator: run a function wrapped with the track_time decorator to automatically profile its execution duration
run_profile_simulation: run an entire simulation inside the profile_simulation context manager to auto enable profile and print report
run_print_report: run print_report to output a formatted performance report with timing breakdown LLM stats and recommendations
